Nilton '''"CrAsH"''' de Souza is a Brazilian Quakeworld and fomer [[Netquake]] player who currently plays [[CTF]] and [[FFA]] from Prague.

He started in [[1996]] playing [[Deathmatch]] and CTF (netquake) in Brazil and stopped in [[1999]]. In [[1997]], together with his Brazilian friends, he created the clan called "BMW" - ''Brazilian Mercenary Wolves''. 

After 21 years he is back, with a late first contact with [[Quakeworld]]. He mostly plays FFA at the servegame server and occasionally joins small tournaments organised by {{Player|bgnr|flag=pt}}, while always ready for any upcoming CTF action.

Nilton will be part of '''"Shining Seagulls"''' in the [[2022]] [[CTF Showdown|CTF Showdown Tournament]].
